ask.description:
Chat with the travel assistant. Describe the trip you want (flights, hotels,
dates, traveler name) in plain text; the assistant converses, writes Python scripts,
and runs them against a simulated travel backend via a script-runner subagent, then
replies with the results.

set_model.description:
Set the model this session uses for subsequent turns. Takes effect on the next
model call, so a turn already in flight finishes on the model it started with.

SetModel.description: Which model this Monty session should use for subsequent turns.
SetModel.title: SetModel

TextMessage.description: Free-form natural-language text from the user (the input to a plain chat handler).
TextMessage.title: TextMessage

TextReply.description: A free-form natural-language reply (the output of a plain chat handler).
TextReply.title: TextReply
